proved_actual_family_results.frobenius_mark: for q congruent to 1 modulo 6, x_q=4^((q-1)/3) and the distinguished root is X_p=x_q*2^((p-1)/3) modulo p
proved_actual_family_results.eisenstein_incidence: after primitive content removal, actual collision is divisibility of the unique Eisenstein branch pair whose label equals the cubic Frobenius value of 2
proved_actual_family_results.unmarked_relation: the Item411 Smith carrier is the union over all three Eisenstein branch labels and therefore forgets the mark
proved_actual_family_results.rational_split: the selected root lies in the rational linear factor exactly when 2 is a cube modulo p, and otherwise in the quadratic factor
proved_actual_family_results.ordinary_selector: on an unmarked primitive row, marked selection is equivalent to cubicality of 2*zeta^(-2) for p=7 mod 18 and 2*zeta^(-1) for p=13 mod 18

proved_scoped_no_go.symmetric_information_class: mu3-symmetric unmarked data can exclude the whole orbit but cannot recover one nonempty branch label without nonsymmetric p-local input
proved_scoped_no_go.fixed_rational_factor: at the same q=7, the selected root is in the quadratic factor for p=13 and in the linear factor for p=31, so no proper q-only rational factor tracks every compatible prime
proved_scoped_no_go.p_mod_18_1: ordinary cubic character is trivial on mu3, so multiplying 2 by powers of the branch label cannot encode the mark as a cube/noncube test
proved_scoped_no_go.scope: these are selector and information-class no-go theorems, not actual wrong-branch support examples

capacity_accounting.reason: carrier-weighted mass may concentrate in uncontrolled Frobenius bins or in the q=5 mod 6 class; ambient prime densities do not control moving carrier divisors
capacity_accounting.sufficient_weighted_target: sum over selected actual incidences of min(v_p(lambda0_m),v_p(lambda1_m))*log(p)=o(m), or radical control plus an independent depth bound

overlap_rules: H_q and G_q^prim describe one primewise union and their logarithms are not independent reservoirs
Item390 owns every p-adic depth of strictly large actual common content; the branch selector is first-digit only
all primes here are greater than 6m and disjoint from booked p<2m Cartier support
excluding common content does not automatically exclude beta matching on the primitive residual target
wrong unmarked branches are not actual common-content primes and cannot be booked negatively or positively

conditional_consequences.full_selected_noncollision: exclusion in q=1 mod 6 together with exclusion of the identical marked/unmarked incidence in q=5 mod 6 proves c_m^>=1
conditional_consequences.weighted_selected_zero_rate: reduces the strictly large common-content component to zero rate
